capabilities: pair devices with a one-time dynamic code
sync note changes across devices in real time
encrypt notes end-to-end with device-held keys
set per-device upload, download, or bidirectional sync
recover deleted notes and roll back to earlier versions
extras: Freemium: a free storage tier exists and larger storage requires a paid plan. The plugin connects to notebooksyncer.com, bijitongbu.site and bijitongbu.cn for syncing and update checks; requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or higher.
problem: Syncing a vault between mobile and desktop usually requires a third-party cloud drive, a VPN in mainland China, or complex configuration.
summary: Vault sync service plugin that pairs phone and computer with a one-time code and syncs notes end-to-end encrypted through its own servers.
